prompt: Je dois reprendre ce projet. Tu peux me faire une visite guidée : point d'entrée, logique métier, module le plus complexe ?
context: Repo root: /work/shop, projet TypeScript, index non construit.
rubric: Recognises the French request as an onboarding tour and applies the workflow
Covers the three requested axes: entry points, business logic, most complex module
Delivers the structured Project Tour report
anti_patterns: Skips the architecture pass and answers from filenames
gold_notes: French triggers in the description: découvrir le projet, visite guidée, point d'entrée, logique métier.

prompt: Before I refactor the pricing code I need to understand the structure around it.
rubric: Builds the two-way picture of pricing.ts: generate_codemap plus find_referencing_files with absolute paths
Runs analyze_file_logic to expose internal call depth and cycles
Warns about blast radius and points to get_impact_analysis before changing signatures
Suggests pr-review on the resulting diff before merging
anti_patterns: Starts proposing refactors before mapping dependents
Uses relative paths in `graph-it tool` calls
gold_notes: The tour is also the pre-refactor safety pass.

prompt: The tour output looks wrong — half the packages are missing.
context: Repo root: /work/platform. `graph-it scan` was run from the user's home directory by mistake.
rubric: Re-runs `graph-it scan` from the correct project (or package) root
Checks index state before trusting further results
Reports the unanalysed area explicitly rather than filling the gap with guesses
For a monorepo, scans per package instead of once at the root
anti_patterns: Describes the missing packages from assumptions
Continues the tour on the broken index
gold_notes: The CLI resolves the workspace from the scan cwd or WORKSPACE_ROOT.

prompt: Turn the analysis into a document I can hand to the new hire.
context: Repo root: /work/shop. Steps 1-6 already run; results available.
rubric: Produces the Project Tour report with the 3 Main Entry Points table (file, role, type)
Includes the Business Logic Core table with exported symbol counts and referenced-by counts
Includes the Most Complex Module section with its concrete signals and a blast-radius recommendation
Includes the Critical Path Mermaid block
Suggests running dead-code-hunter afterwards so the new hire reads less noise
anti_patterns: Delivers prose without the report tables
Invents metric values not produced by the commands
gold_notes: Report shape is part of the skill contract; related skills close the loop.
